sources.label: 火車時刻表的morphe patches
sources.author: TWRailway
patch_list: Shows up to 20 recent searches instead of 3. The number can be changed in the patch settings.
Shows the app name instead of "app.titleTra" as the app's title in the recent apps screen.
Shows the expanded limit (such as "(5/20)") in the count next to 搜尋歷史, and removes the "升級" text. It can be turned off in the patch settings.
Stops the app from loading banner, interstitial, native and app open ads, and removes the empty space reserved for the banner.

Stops the subscription promotion popups (discount, holiday sale and widget intro) that only free users see, and hides the "升級即時看板" link of the free home screen widgets. Paid features are not unlocked.
Stops the "喜歡這個App嗎？" dialog asking to rate the app from showing.
Hides the subscribe button (such as "付費移除廣告，免開app 直接查") of the search pages. It can be shown again in the patch settings.
Adds a "修補設定" page to turn the other patches on or off and adjust them while the app runs. It replaces the "廣告設定" item in the drawer's 設定 section, and is also a shortcut on the app icon.
